summary.result: The estimated R-squareds were close to 1, which means that the embankment was steady state without movement of soil particles.
summary.background: In this study the pore water pressures were measured in sea dike constructed with the sand dredged in the sea, and they were analyzed with the hydraulic head loss rate to estimate quantitatively the state of blocking seepage in the sea dike embankment.
summary.method: The deeper the installed position was the lower the hydraulic head loss rate was and the longer the seepage path length was the higher the hydraulic head loss rate was.
